title: Refund Policy and Cancellation Guidelines
content:
CloudDash aims to provide a transparent and fair billing experience. Our refund policy is strictly defined to ensure consistency across all customer accounts.

## 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee

CloudDash offers a 30-day money-back guarantee exclusively for **new paid subscribers** activating their first subscription on the Starter or Pro plans.

If you decide CloudDash isn't the right fit within the first 30 days of your initial purchase:
1. Cancel your subscription via **Settings → Billing → Cancel Subscription**.
2. Contact billing@clouddash.io with your workspace name and invoice number.
3. A full refund will be processed to your original payment method within 5-7 business days.

**Exceptions to the Guarantee:**
- Requests made after 30 days from the first payment.
- Accounts with exceptionally high usage (exceeding 80% of plan limits) during the 30-day period.
- Enterprise plan contracts (these are governed by custom terms).

## Standard Refund Policy (Outside 30 Days)

Outside of the initial 30-day window, CloudDash subscriptions are non-refundable.

- **Monthly Subscriptions:** If you cancel mid-month, you will retain access until the end of the billing cycle. No partial refunds are issued.
- **Annual Subscriptions:** If you cancel an annual plan early, you retain access until the end of the paid year. We do not provide prorated cash refunds for unused months on annual plans.

## Plan Downgrades

When downgrading from Pro to Starter, or from an Annual to a Monthly cycle, no cash refunds are issued for the difference. Instead, any remaining prepaid balance is converted into an **account credit**, which is automatically applied to future CloudDash invoices.

## Service Outage Compensation

If CloudDash experiences a significant service outage that violates our Service Level Agreement (SLA), compensation is provided as service credits, not cash refunds. SLA credits must be requested by opening a support ticket within 15 days of the incident.

## Unrecognised Charges

If you see a charge from CloudDash that you do not recognise, please contact billing@clouddash.io immediately before initiating a chargeback with your bank. Chargebacks result in immediate account suspension.
